# Pull Request

## Summary

<!-- Describe your changes and the motivation. Link any related issues. -->

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing behavior to change)
- [ ] Spec update (behavioral change captured in `docs/specs/`)

## Checklist

- [ ] I read the relevant spec(s) in `docs/specs/` before coding.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for my changes.
- [ ] I ran `dart format .`, `flutter analyze`, and `flutter test`.
- [ ] I updated the relevant spec(s) if the user-visible behavior changed.
- [ ] I followed the project rules in `AGENTS.md`.
